title: Find a value by label
summary: Ruby: Find a value by label. Read :pages instead.
introduction: A hash pairs keys with values. :title is a symbol used as a key.
learningObjectives: Find a value by label with Ruby

blocks.text: Install Ruby 3.1 or later. Save one example as lesson.rb and run ruby lesson.rb in a terminal.

blocks.title: Find a value by label
blocks.code:
book = { title: "Moon Trip", pages: 24 }
puts book[:title]

blocks.text: The :title symbol selects Moon Trip. :pages would select a different value.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The symbol :title and the string "title" are different keys.
